description: Virtual Beach is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency; Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources; Wisconsin Sea Grant. This decision-support software package generates statistical models to predict levels of disease-causing pathogens at specific beach sites. Managers can use it to help guide decisions on beach closures for public health reasons. Climate change-related effects on lake and coastal ecosystems (such as warming waters and intense precipitation) can result in unsafe conditions for recreation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Vector-Borne Disease, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
